description: The bar chart, titled "Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling," presents a comparative analysis of various large language models (LLMs) across two benchmark datasets: MATH-500 and AIME24. The chart is divided into six subplots (a–f), each illustrating performance metrics for different model configurations and settings. In subplot (a), which focuses on MATH-500, the performance of models with 3B and 405B parameters is compared, with the 3B model (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct) achieving a score of 78.2, while the 405B model (TTS) scores 71.4. Subplot (b) shows that on MATH-500, the 1.5B model (ol-mini) achieves a score of 91.6, outperforming the 405B model (GPT-4o) with a score of 90.0. Subplot (c) compares models with 671B, 7B, and unknown parameters, where the 671B model (Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct) scores 97.3, the 7B model (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B) scores 95.2, and the unknown model (ol) scores 94.8. Subplot (d) on AIME24 shows that the 3B model (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct) scores 30.0, the 405B model (Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct) scores 23.3, and the unknown model (ol) scores 9.3. Subplot (e) compares models with unknown and 1.5B parameters, where the unknown model (ol-mini) scores 63.6, the 1.5B model (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B) scores 63.3, and the unknown model (ol) scores 44.6. Finally, subplot (f) shows that the 7B model (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B) scores 83.3, the 671B model (DeepSeek-R1) scores 79.8, and the unknown model (ol) scores 79.2. The chart uses different colors and patterns to represent various models, with a legend at the top indicating the model names and their corresponding visual representations. The y-axis represents the performance score, ranging from 65 to 100 for MATH-500 and from 0 to 90 for AIME24. The x-axis represents the different models and their configurations. The chart highlights the performance of different models across different parameter sizes and benchmarks, providing insights into the effectiveness of test-time scaling and model size in achieving high performance.
